name: branding-burgundy-corner-and-lotus-footer-letterhead-on-stand
title: Burgundy Corner Letterhead with Lotus Footer
whatItIs: A letterhead standing on a grey plinth with a burgundy L-shaped corner band holding a bird logo at the top right, a thin vertical burgundy line by the body text and a lotus flourish above the footer contacts, plus a dark-grey sheet with a cut-out logo tab peeking below.
whatItMeans: A single corner band and one flourish keep the page mostly white and elegant while still branded.
techniques: Corner band that wraps two edges
Vertical accent rule beside the body copy
Paper standing upright on a plinth
Two contrasting sheets shown in one scroll

vocabulary.definition: A colour band that turns a corner along two edges.
A decorative shape used as ornament.
A paper piece standing on a block for presentation.
